abstract: RNA sequencing analysis pipeline using STAR, RSEM, HISAT2 or Salmon with gene/isoform counts and extensive quality control.

metadata.name: rnaseq

releases.body:
A release with new options to fail a run on failed per-sample checks, a move to the `nf-core-utils` plugin, and several bug fixes. Two changes alter behaviour and are marked below.

### New features

- New `--fail_on_low_trimmed_reads`, `--fail_on_low_mapped_reads` and `--fail_on_undetermined_strandedness` options fail the run instead of silently skipping the sample or defaulting to `unstranded` ([#1969](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1969))

### Fixes

- Fix `HISAT2_ALIGN` running for only one sample when the HISAT2 index is built in-run ([#1994](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1994) by @janaki-bio)
- Apply `--min_mapped_reads` filtering to HISAT2 alignments ([#1943](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1943))
- Leave samples failing `--min_mapped_reads` out of Salmon/RSEM quantification and the merged count tables, so such samples no longer get aligner-based counts (behaviour change), and document the MultiQC fail tables ([#1984](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1984))
- Stop building the SortMeRNA index twice, and build the Salmon strandedness-inference index centrally in `PREPARE_GENOME_INDICES` ([#1958](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1958))
- Skip the strandedness-inference Salmon index for BAM-only `auto` samples, stop an unparsed HISAT2 alignment rate dropping every sample, and fix the `EAUTILS_GTF2BED` conda lock paths ([#2001](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/2001))
- Fix `--with_umi` transcriptome-side samtools stats silently colliding with genome-side stats ([#1942](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1942))
- Stop a library with no quantified reads crashing the SummarizedExperiment merge and DESeq2 QC ([#1986](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1986))
- Fix duplicated valueless flags passed via `--extra_trimgalore_args` ([#1968](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1968) by @jaredfischbach)
- Remove the `cpus = 1` override for RiboDetector ([#1972](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1972) by @jaredfischbach)
- Right-size `RSEM_CALCULATEEXPRESSION` resources, drop its unused BAM output, and stop pinning `--seed 1` in its default arguments ([#1959](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1959))
- Use `size()` instead of the `size` property on lists in samplesheet validation, which fails on Nextflow 26.11 and later ([#1990](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1990) by @bentsherman)
- Declare `force_completion_email` in the config and schema, and test `--fail_on_low_trimmed_reads` and `--fail_on_low_mapped_reads` ([#1999](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1999))

### Updates

- Replace the vendored `utils_*` subworkflows with the `nf-core-utils@0.7.0` plugin; the completion email is skipped on Seqera Platform launches unless `params.force_completion_email = true` (behaviour change) ([#1977](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1977) by @edmundmiller)
- Update Salmon to 2.11.0, restoring `--noLengthCorrection` for 3' tag data such as QuantSeq ([#1991](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1991))
- Update Parabricks to 4.8.0-1, so the Parabricks run log no longer overwrites STAR's `Log.final.out` ([#1978](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1978) by @gburnett-nvidia)
- Template updates for nf-core/tools v4.2.1 and v4.2.2 ([#1980](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1980), [#2000](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/2000))
- Module bumps: FastQC 0.13.0, fastp 1.4.0, samtools 1.25, and bowtie2 2.5.5 with fixed version parsing and rebuilt containers ([#1993](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1993), [#1997](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/pull/1997))

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/nf-core/rnaseq/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#3280---2026-11-10) for all 25 merged PRs.
